_comment: Model profiles for setup.ps1 -Profile <name>. 'split' holds measured sizes (GiB) used to compute -ncmoe; profiles without it use llama.cpp's automatic --fit. 'tested' = benchmarked on the reference PC (RTX 4070 12 GB, Ryzen 7 7700X, 64 GB DDR5).

qwen36-35b.description: Default. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q4_K_M (MoE, 3B active). 12+ GB VRAM, 32+ GB RAM.

qwen36-35b-small.description: Same model, UD-IQ3_XXS (13.2 GB). For 8 GB VRAM and/or 16-24 GB RAM. Lower quality than Q4.

qwen36-35b-q8.description: Same model, UD-Q8_K_XL (38.5 GB): near-lossless. For 24 GB VRAM + 64 GB RAM.

qwen38-27b.description: Qwen3.8-27B dense UD-Q4_K_M (16.5 GB). Preferred on 24 GB+ GPUs: fits fully in VRAM, stronger than Qwen3.6 (TB4 6% vs 0%). Too slow if it doesn't fit (~4 tok/s).

qwen38-flash-next.description: Best model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q3_K_XL (~90 GB, 3 shards), 6B active. For 128 GB RAM / unified memory. TB4 25%. Needs a llama.cpp new enough for arch 'qwen4exp'.
